prompts.ready: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: actual transparent PNG sprite sheet for a tiny desktop bunny named Clover. Create exactly EIGHT chronological poses in FOUR columns and TWO rows of equal square cells, no gutters, canvas1536 x768 target. Clover is a compact cream-colored rabbit with two long upright ears with muted pink inner ears, a small warm taupe patch over its right ear tip, big dark chocolate eyes, tiny pink triangular nose, cream round cheeks, short squat body, chunky little front paws, broad hind feet and a small round fluffy tail on its right. No clothing, collar or props. Crisp pixel-art game sprite, deliberate blocky pixels, limited cream/taupe/pink palette, strong warm dark-brown outline, simple flat shading, three-quarter front view. Same identity and proportions throughout. Full bunny including ear tips and tail visible in every cell with ample clear alpha space; fixed scale and camera, facial center near50% cellwidth, resting feet at82% cellheight, whole bunny about60% cellheight. Keep its two ears long but within the same cell. Idle animation:1 complete neutral seated bunny eyesopen;2 tiny nose twitch,3 gentle breathing and one ear tip bends slightly,4 halfclosedeyes,5 closedeye blink,6 eyesreopen,7 earsreturn,8 return to neutral frame1. Paws and body baseline stay fixed; subtle motion only. Ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Background and gaps between ears and limbs must be genuine alpha transparency. No text, cell labels, gridlines, ground shadows, effects, sparkle, glow, checkerboard, scene, extra limbs, clipped ears or shifting scale. This sheet establishes the canonical bunny reference.
